name: Metals Extraction and Urban Mining
description: This course introduces the principles and processes of metal extraction from natural ores and urban sources. It begins with the motivation for studying metal extraction, types of metal-bearing minerals, and key extraction routes. Topics include mineral beneficiation, ore sorting, and the role of metallurgical fuels and furnaces. Core extraction methods—pyrometallurgy, hydrometallurgy, and electrometallurgy—are covered with emphasis on thermodynamics, kinetics, and major industrial practices. The course concludes with urban mining, highlighting sustainable alternatives for metal recovery from electronic waste and batteries, along with emerging trends in automation and AI/ML-assisted extraction technologies.
